name: Custom Business Metrics Dashboard
description: Custom business KPIs and user behavior analytics

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM CustomBusinessEvent TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 75) FROM CustomUserBehavior TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM CustomFeatureUsage TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM CustomBusinessEvent FACET eventType SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(duration) FROM CustomUserBehavior FACET feature SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM CustomFeatureUsage FACET featureCategory SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(value) FROM CustomBusinessEvent FACET userSegment SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM CustomUserBehavior FACET behaviorType, feature TIMESERIES 30 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT featureName, sum(usageCount), average(sessionDuration) FROM CustomFeatureUsage SINCE 24 hours ago ORDER BY sum(usageCount) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT behaviorType, feature, average(duration), count(*) FROM CustomUserBehavior WHERE success = true SINCE 24 hours ago ORDER BY average(duration) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT average(kpiValue) FROM CustomBusinessKPI FACET kpiName TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 24 hours ago
